---
title: "Crew Log Report"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
crew <- read_csv("astronauts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Age at first flight

```{r}
#| label: tbl-age
#| echo: false
age_table <- crew |>
  filter(mission_number == 1) |>
  mutate(decade = paste0(floor(year_of_mission / 10) * 10, "s"),
         age = year_of_mission - year_of_birth) |>
  group_by(decade) |>
  summarise(n = n(), M = mean(age), SD = sd(age))

knitr::kable(age_table, digits = 2, col.names = c("Decade", "*n*", "*M*", "*SD*"),
             caption = "Age at First Flight by Decade")
```
